index_eyebrow1: Interior Design & Renovation — Dallas / Fort Worth
index_quote1: Your home has a story. *Let's tell it beautifully.*
index_text1:
Designed for the life you really live.
Creating spaces where great memories happen.
index_text2: For thirty years, Bonnie Roden was the friend everyone called — the one who could walk into a home and see what it was trying to become.
index_text3: In 2024, she finally put her name on a door. Hearten Home Interiors is the business she spent three decades building without knowing it, and her goal is as simple as it is rare: to make you feel better about your home…and to truly love it. For you to have an atmosphere that refreshes and inspires you…not just because it's beautiful, but because it's a reflection of you. She designs with purpose: thoughtful spaces that work beautifully, live well, and last.
index_text4: From full-scale renovations to intentional room styling and holiday readiness, Bonnie guides the creative direction from the very first mood board to the final walk-through.
index_text5: Every detail is handled — the contractors, the timelines, the decisions — so you can simply step into your new space and enjoy.

reviews.quote: Hearten Home Interiors is simply the best, and what sets them apart goes far beyond their incredible work. From the very beginning, they were warm, kind, and genuinely understanding. They took every idea we had and turned it into the dream home we always envisioned. The results of our remodel, design, and decorating exceeded every expectation. What we did not expect was walking away with more than a beautiful home. We walked away with a friendship that will last a lifetime.

I can't begin to sing Bonnie and Tripp Roden's praises enough! They took an ugly bathroom and transformed it into a Ralph Lauren-style showstopper. The project, from start to finish, was absolutely seamless. We repeatedly commented about how quick and painless the process was. This is largely because Bonnie and Tripp are super organized, communicate regularly, manage each step, and have a terrific team of expert plumbers, electricians, carpenters, and flooring specialists. They also honored our budget, which was a big plus. I already have my next remodeling project planned with Hearten Home Interiors!
